results.note: Epistola de Judaicis superstitionibus by Agobard (9th c.). A blog translation by Aymenn al-Tamimi exists (aymennaltamimi.com), but this appears to be a custom commissioned translation rather than a published scholarly edition (no FOTC, ACW, or TTH attribution).
Collectanea (vol. 129). A collection attributed to Anastasius Bibliothecarius (9th c.). No English translation of this specific compilation found; it exists only in Latin in Migne.
Testamentum (vol. 134). A miscellaneous collection. No English translation found in standard patristic translation series.
Fragmenta et notulae graecorum operum (vol. 2). Scholarly apparatus and fragments. No standalone English translation identified.
Fragmenta mentio et notulae (vol. 2). Scholarly fragments and notes. No standalone English translation identified.
Epistolae confessorum Romanorum et Carthaginensium (vol. 3). Collection of letters from early confessors/martyrs. No English translation found.
Supplementum adnotationum (vol. 5). Supplementary apparatus notes to Migne's collection. No English translation found.

Testimonia de Lactantio (vol. 6). A collection of testimonia (quotations/references) ABOUT Lactantius. While Lactantius' Divine Institutes has English translations (ANF, FOTC, TTH), this testimonia collection itself has no English translation.
Monumenta vetera (vol. 8). Collection of ancient documents. No English translation identified.
Selecta testimonia de S. Hilario (vol. 9). Testimonia (quotations) ABOUT Hilary of Poitiers. While Hilary's own Select Works exist in English, this testimonia collection has no English translation.
Leges in Donatistas (vol. 11). Laws related to the Donatist controversy. No standalone English translation found.
Monumenta vetera ad historiam Donatistarum pertinentia (vol. 11). Ancient documents relating to Donatist history. No English translation identified despite scholarly interest in Donatism.

Testimonia selecta de S. Zenone (vol. 11). Testimonia collection ABOUT Saint Zeno of Verona. While some of Zeno's homilies have English translations, this testimonia collection itself has no English translation.
Tractatus (vol. 11). Unspecified treatise fragment. Insufficient information to confirm any English translation.
Veterum fragmenta de Donatistis (vol. 11). Ancient fragments about Donatism. No English translation found.

Veterum testimonia de Optato et eius libris (vol. 11 and others). Testimonia collection ABOUT Optatus of Milevis. While Optatus' own work 'Against the Donatists' has an English translation (1917, Vassall-Phillips; available in Tertullian Project), this testimonia collection itself has no English translation.

Selecta veterum testimonia de S. Philastrio (vol. 12). Testimonia collection ABOUT Philastrius. Philastrius' Diversarum hereseon liber has no complete published English translation. No translation of this testimonia collection found.
Addenda (vol. 13). Migne's addenda/supplementary material. No English translation of this apparatus material found.
Epistolae et decreta (vol. 13). Collection of letters and decrees. No standalone English translation identified.
Selecta veterum testimonia (vol. 14). Testimonia collection of unspecified subject. No English translation found.

Philosophorum aliquot epistolae (vol. 17). Collection of letters from Greek philosophers. While various individual philosophical texts have been translated, this specific Migne compilation has no identified English translation.

Sermones S. Ambrosio hactenus ascripti (vol. 17). Sermons attributed to Ambrose but of uncertain authorship. While some pseudo-Ambrose texts (like 'On the Sacraments') have translations, this specific sermonic collection's translation status is unclear.
Elogia Symmachiana (vol. 18 and others). Commemorative verses about Symmachus. No English translation found despite scholarly interest in Symmachus.

Testimonia de P. Optatiano Porphyrio et al. (vol. 19-186). Large composite work containing testimonia about Optatian Porphyrius and multiple other figures (Isidore of Seville, John Scotus Eriugena, Ivo of Chartres, etc.). While the individual subjects have some translated works, this testimonia compilation itself has no English translation.
Testimonia selecta (vol. 20). Testimonia collection of unspecified subject. No English translation found.
Testimonia veterum (vol. 20 and others). Composite testimonia collection about multiple figures (Flavio Lucio Dextro, John of Rouen, etc.). No English translation found.

Testimonia veterum de S. Hieronymo (vol. 22). Testimonia collection ABOUT Saint Jerome. While Jerome's own works (De viris illustribus, Letters) are translated in NPNF, this testimonia collection has no English translation.
Epistolae (vol. 31). Brief epistolary fragment (126 words). No English translation identified.

Liber sententiarum (vol. 40). Collection of sentences/theological excerpts. This is NOT Peter Lombard's Sentences (which are translated). No English translation of this specific Migne compilation found.
Excerpta pertinentia ad historiam Donatistarum (vol. 43). Excerpts relating to Donatist history. No English translation found.
Scripta et monumenta historiae Pelagianorum (vol. 45). Writings and documents relating to Pelagian history/controversy. No English translation identified despite scholarly interest in Pelagianism.
Appendicula: Vetera monumenta (vol. 52). Appendicular ancient documents. No English translation found.
Testimonia de S. Valeriano (vol. 52). Testimonia collection ABOUT Saint Valerian. No English translation found.

Testimonia veterum de S. Niceta (vol. 52). Testimonia collection ABOUT Nicetas of Remesiana. While Nicetas' own writings exist in English (FOTC series), this testimonia collection has no English translation.
Prolegomena (vol. 53). Introductory apparatus material. No English translation of this Migne apparatus found.
Testimonia (vol. 54). Testimonia collection of unspecified subject. No English translation found.
Antiquissima interpretatio canonum (vol. 56). Ancient interpretation/translation of church canons. No modern English translation identified.

Appendix ad opera S. Leonis Magni (vol. 56). Appendix to Leo the Great's works containing canons, constitutions, dissertations. While Leo's own letters/writings are in NPNF2:12, the status of this appendix specifically is unclear.
Documenta juris canonici veteris (vol. 56). Documents of early canon law. No modern English translation identified.
Prisca editio canonum (vol. 56). Ancient Latin translation of Eastern canons (Prisca recension). No modern English translation of this canonical compilation found.
Vetus interpretatio canonum (vol. 56). Vetus (Old Latin) translation/interpretation of canons. No modern English translation identified.
Collatio episcoporum (vol. 59). Conference/collection of bishop materials. No English translation found.
De incarnatione et gratia (vol. 62). Theological treatise on incarnation and grace. No English translation identified.
Anathematismi et fidei professio (vol. 65). Anathemas and profession of faith. No English translation found.

Codex canonum ecclesiasticorum (vol. 67). Collection of ecclesiastical canons. While ecumenical council canons are translated (NPNF2:14), this specific canonical compilation's translation status remains unconfirmed.
